summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 21 tests) + frontend (Playwright) testing for ÉVORA luxury fashion e-commerce. All backend APIs (auth, products, cart, wishlist, newsletter, categories) pass with 100% success. Frontend homepage, shop, product detail, login, wishlist, theme toggle, search overlay, cart drawer, quick-view dialog, filters and sort all functional.

minor.issue: Search regex only matches the 'name' field, not category/description. Searching 'Hoodie' returns 0 results because no product name contains 'Hoodie' (category is 'Hoodies' but product names are e.g. 'Nocturne Hooded Sweatshirt'). Consider broadening search.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers will reject credentialed XHR. Currently works because frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage, not cookies. If switching to cookie-only auth, set explicit FRONTEND_URL origin.

issues: Several Unsplash images contain visible third-party brand logos (e.g., 'Reebok' on hero sweatshirt, 'Michael Kors' on the Nocturne Hooded Sweatshirt model's bag). For a fictional luxury brand 'ÉVORA', images showing competitor branding undermine the premium minimal aesthetic. Suggest curating images without visible third-party logos.

action_items: (Optional) Broaden product search to include category/description fields, or document that search only matches name
(Optional) Replace hero & trending product images that show visible competitor brand logos (Reebok, Michael Kors) for brand coherence
(Optional) If moving to cookie-only auth, replace CORS '*' with explicit FRONTEND_URL and keep allow_credentials=True
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 637 lines — acceptable but approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/products.py, etc. as features grow
seed_admin correctly updates the admin password when changed via env (good idempotent seeding)
All routes correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection {_id:0}
bcrypt hashes used correctly ($2b$); JWT secret read from env
Auth supports both httpOnly cookie and Bearer token — flexible, but mixed-mode increases attack surface; pick one for production
No brute-force lockout implemented on /auth/login (the playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Not critical for MVP without checkout, but worth noting
test_credentials: Admin: admin@evora.com / Evora@2026 (seeded). Test user: test@evora.com / Test@1234 (registered during test).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 12 products and 1 admin user on startup. Tests register test@evora.com if missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passes pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_evora_api.py. Use admin@evora.com/Evora@2026 for admin and test@evora.com/Test@1234 for regular user. Token stored in localStorage as 'evora_token' and sent as Bearer. Product IDs are UUIDs on field 'id' (not _id). All UI elements have data-testid. The /api/products search is name-only.
